200.title: Polish Supreme Court rejects government’s position on Constitutional Tribunal
200.summary: Polish Supreme Court rejects government’s position on Constitutional Tribunal Nov 19, 2026 | Law , Politics Why are you seeing adverts on our website for the first time?
200.body: Polish Supreme Court rejects government’s position on Constitutional Tribunal Nov 19, 2026 | Law , Politics Why are you seeing adverts on our website for the first time? Poland’s rule-of-law crisis has taken another twist, after the Supreme Court (SN) issued a resolution effectively opposing the government’s position towards another top court, the Constitutional Tribunal (TK), and endorsing that of opposition-aligned President Karol Nawrocki. However, Nawrocki and the TK’s chief justice, Bogdan Święczkowski, who was appointed under the former government, reject that position and say that the judges cannot take up their seats on the court until the president receives their oath in person.

200.title: Poland was aware of Russian border sabotage plot and took action – Polish Defence Ministry
200.summary: Polish Minister of National Defence Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz has commented on media reports that Russian intelligence services planned to carry out a sabotage operation on Polish territory near the border with Russia's Kaliningrad Oblast in late October and early November which they intended to be blamed on Ukraine.
200.body: Polish Minister of National Defence Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz has commented on media reports that Russian intelligence services planned to carry out a sabotage operation on Polish territory near the border with Russia's Kaliningrad Oblast in late October and early November which they intended to be blamed on Ukraine. Source: European Pravda, citing Polish radio station RMF24 Details: Kosiniak-Kamysz stressed that the Polish intelligence services had been aware of the plans and taken appropriate measures. Background: In early November, the Polish police, working alongside the armed forces, the border guard service and the security service, established a special operations headquarters for a preventive security mission in the Warmian-Masurian and Podlaskie voivodeships to prepare for possible sabotage on the border with Kaliningrad Oblast. On 3 November, Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said that "suspicious activity" had been observed overnight on the Russian-Polish border.

300.title: Can the Moon make money? Polish firm to test lunar mining business
300.summary: Adobe Stock A Polish company will lead a European Space Agency (ESA)-backed study into whether extracting water, oxygen, helium-3 and other resources on the Moon could become a profitable business, and what infrastructure would be needed to make it work.
300.body: Adobe Stock A Polish company will lead a European Space Agency (ESA)-backed study into whether extracting water, oxygen, helium-3 and other resources on the Moon could become a profitable business, and what infrastructure would be needed to make it work. MIRORES will head the LUNAVEST consortium, which will assess the costs of extracting, processing, storing and transporting lunar resources, as well as the potential demand for them. The model will combine information about lunar resources with estimates of extraction and processing costs, infrastructure investment, maintenance, energy supplies, transport and potential revenue. For Polish companies, the work could provide an opportunity to contribute both to the identification of lunar resources and to planning the infrastructure and commercial activities needed to develop a future lunar economy. (PAP) akp/ bar/ tr.

500.title: Gemini 4 Neon brings Google’s cheaper AI model for coding and analysis
500.summary: Gemini 4 Neon brings Google’s cheaper AI model for coding and analysis Last updated: November 19, 2026 10:54 am By DNE Africa 6 Min Read Share Illustration: AI-generated for DNE Africa SHARE Google has released Gemini 4 Neon, an AI model it says delivers near top-tier performance on coding, analysis and science tasks at lower cost, priced at $3 per million input tokens, the company said on Wednesday.
500.body: Gemini 4 Neon brings Google’s cheaper AI model for coding and analysis Last updated: November 19, 2026 10:54 am By DNE Africa 6 Min Read Share Illustration: AI-generated for DNE Africa SHARE Google has released Gemini 4 Neon, an AI model it says delivers near top-tier performance on coding, analysis and science tasks at lower cost, priced at $3 per million input tokens, the company said on Wednesday. Gemini 4 Neon sits below Google’s largest model in the family and is designed for long, multi-step tasks such as debugging code across files, analysing spreadsheets and documents, and running “agents” that complete work with little supervision, according to Google’s announcement , written by Koray Kavukcuoglu, chief AI architect at Google. Gemini 4 Neon is rolling out in the Gemini API through Google AI Studio, to business customers, in the Google Antigravity coding tool for paid AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, and in the Gemini app for Pro and Ultra subscribers, Google said.
